msg: Hey! I'm an American diver, Advanced Open Water. I'm renting a house on Airbnb on Isla Grande next week, it's called Villa Marea. I'd like to do two dives. Can you pick me up there? How does that work?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a great way to explore the reefs around Isla Grande! For two certified dives, pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge if your Airbnb has maritime access. Pick-up is usually between *9:30 and 9:45 a.m.*; sometimes the boat comes directly to the property, and sometimes you’ll meet at the nearest dock.

Since Villa Marea is an Airbnb, a team advisor needs to confirm the exact pick-up point and logistics. Would you like me to connect you with an advisor?

msg: Sure, but first: how much is it and can I book it online now, or do I have to wait for the advisor to confirm the pick-up? Also, I last dove about 6 months ago.
reply:
You can book online now; the booking link lets you choose your date and number of people. Villa Marea is an Airbnb, so the pick-up point still needs to be confirmed by an advisor. You don’t need to wait for that confirmation to book, but please make sure the pick-up is arranged with the team. Your last dive was about six months ago, so the refresher option for divers who have been out of the water for more than two years doesn’t apply.

Book your two dives online: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/fun-dives-already-on-island/19?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD
• Fun Dives - 1 dive (1 day): 97 USD · 108 USD
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 188 USD · 209 USD

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

msg: Just me. One more thing: the house doesn't have its own dock as far as I know. If I book and pay and the boat can't get to the house, what happens? Is lunch included, by the way?
reply:
If Villa Marea doesn’t have boat access, the team will confirm the nearest dock or meeting point for your pick-up. Boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge when you’re staying on the islands, provided the hotel or arranged meeting point has maritime access. Lunch isn’t included for island-based dives; water throughout the day and coconut candy between dives are included.

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day, already on the islands)*
💰 *124 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), dive insurance, full diving equipment and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.
📍 Pickup at your island hotel.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/fun-dives-already-on-island/19?language=en

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿

msg: OK, great. Please connect me with the advisor so we can sort out the pick-up at Villa Marea.
reply:
Hotel pick-up is between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m., if Villa Marea has boat access. Pick-up and return by boat are included at no extra charge. In some cases, the boat can reach the house directly; otherwise, the team will indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.

I'll connect you with an advisor from the Diving Planet team.
They will contact you shortly. Thanks! :)
